tagline: One of the world's largest private owners of timberlands, maximizing long-term forest value sustainably.
hero_kpi_rationale: Weyerhaeuser owns or controls over 10 million acres of timberlands in the U.S. and manages long-term licenses covering over 14 million acres in Canada, positioning it as one of the world's largest private timberland owners with sustainable forestry practices.

kpis.name: Timberlands Owned or Controlled
kpis.explanation: Area of timberlands owned or controlled by the company in the United States.
kpis.description: Weyerhaeuser manages these lands sustainably in accordance with international forestry standards to maximize their long-term value.
kpis.signal: The company is one of the world's largest private owners of timberlands.

kpis.name: Managed Licenses in Canada
kpis.explanation: Area of timberlands under long-term licenses managed by the company in Canada.
kpis.description: Weyerhaeuser manages long-term licenses covering over 14 million acres in Canada.
kpis.signal: Sustainable management of Canadian forests complementing the U.S. ownership base.

kpis.name: Wood Products Manufacturing Facilities
kpis.explanation: Number of wood products manufacturing facilities operated in the United States and Canada.
kpis.description: Weyerhaeuser produces lumber, oriented strand board, engineered wood products, and other specialty products for residential, multi-family, repair and remodel, and light commercial markets.
kpis.signal: The company is one of the largest wood products manufacturers in North America.

kpis.name: Annual Tree Seedlings Planted
kpis.explanation: Number of tree seedlings planted each year as part of sustainable reforestation practices.
kpis.description: Weyerhaeuser plants over 100 million tree seedlings annually, equivalent to approximately 190 trees per minute year-round, ensuring 100% reforestation of harvested timberlands.
kpis.signal: Commitment to sustainable reforestation with over 190 trees planted per minute.

kpis.name: Scope 1 Carbon Emissions
kpis.explanation: Direct Scope 1 greenhouse gas emissions from company operations.
kpis.description: In 2024, Weyerhaeuser's Scope 1 carbon emissions were 0.4 million metric tons of carbon dioxide equivalent, reflecting a commitment to reducing greenhouse gas emissions.
kpis.signal: The company removes significantly more carbon from the atmosphere than it emits annually.

risks.title: Economic Conditions
risks.score_rationale: The health of the U.S. housing market strongly affects the performance of all business segments. Fluctuations in demand for wood products impact revenues and margins.

risks.title: Trade and Tariff Regulation
risks.score_rationale: Changes in trade policies and tariffs can affect the company's wood product exports.

risks.title: Intense Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in highly competitive national and international markets, with numerous competitors offering similar products.

risks.title: Environmental and Forestry Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company faces environmental risks related to sustainable forest management, biodiversity, and water quality.

risks.title: Climate Change
risks.score_rationale: Climate change may have significant impacts on forest resource availability, tree growth patterns, and future regulation.

risks.title: Production Cost Inflation
risks.score_rationale: Inflation affects the company's operating, labor, and transportation costs, impacting profit margins.

risks.title: Interest Rates and Financing
risks.score_rationale: Higher interest rates increase financing costs and may impact the company's ability to fund operations and manage debt.
